title: Run feed: structured real-time event stream for dashboards and widgets
description: Operator idea (2026-09-08, during the Phase 1 gate run): ticfac should emit a detailed, structured (JSON) feed of a run — checkpoints, stages per tick, attempts, dispatch/heartbeat/collect events, gate evidence, decisions — consumable in real time by client dashboards and widgets (herdr mission control, a web board, a menu-bar widget, the operator channel). Today the only observables are the .ticfac/ records on the integration branch and the executor's observations.jsonl, and a headless run has no herdr presence at all, so an operator cannot see that workers are alive. Candidate shape: one append-only JSONL event stream per run (the reconciler's journal stages + executor observations, with the run/tick/attempt identity on every line), written locally and optionally mirrored (file tail, HTTP/SSE, or the run-state store), with a versioned event schema in the contract bundle so every client parses the same thing. Roadmap placement is the human's call — proposed for the retro.
acceptance_criteria: To be planned: event schema in the contract bundle; the reconciler and executor emit every stage/observation as an event with identity; a reference consumer (e.g. the herdr-ticks dashboard) renders a live run from the feed alone.
